notes.title: Til Nord Update 29-6-2021
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying Til Nord!

Patch notes for this update:

[b]Added[/b]
- Added Photo Mode
- Added UI for the radio
- Added snow particle trail to the snowmobile
- Added various new achievements
- Ramps are now also considered collectables
- Added hue slider to the skin selection screen

[b]Changed[/b]
- The frozen wind turbine doesn't rotate any more until you complete the mission associated with it
- Replayable missions are now greyed out on the compass
- Compass icons now display how far away the objective is
- Changed mission icons
- The "Food Delivery" time trial now counts up like the other time trials
- Days are now longer, and nights are shorter
- Made the night slightly brighter than it was before
- The front- and rear lights of the snowmobile now visibly turn on
- The snowmobile's track now rotates while driving
- Changed the way the mission UI looks
- Mission checkpoints are now slightly larger than they were before
- The invisible walls around bodies of water have been removed
- The game's settings can now be accessed from inside the game
- Optimized some parts of the game

[b]Fixed[/b]
- The game no longer starts at night if you start a new game after unlocking any 'discovery text'
- The main menu now has controller focus when no save data is present
- Mission text should now always show up when continuing the game while in a mission
- The player can no longer interact with missions after crashing their snowmobile
- The overlay that is displayed after crashing now shows button icons
- After crashing, the radio only needs to be turned on once to actually turn on

[b]Known Issues[/b]
- The camera pushes in the opposite direction when moving 'too fast' with the mouse

notes.title: Til Nord Update 14-6-2021
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying Til Nord!

Patch notes for this update:

[b]Added[/b]
- Added first-person mode
- Added context-based hints
- Added new missions: "Onboarding", "Roadblock"
- Added new time trials: "Food Delivery", "Forest Race", "Hill Race", "Offroad Drift"
- Added Steam leaderboards for time trials
- Added in-game radio
- Added intro cinematic
- Added various new achievements
- Enabled Steam Cloud Sync
- Added Steam controller configuration for PS3, PS4 and Nintendo Switch Pro controllers

[b]Changed[/b]
- Mission beams are no longer a solid color
- Cinematics can now be skipped
- Updated engine sound
- Mission checkpoint markers now stick to the edge of the compass when the checkpoint is behind the player
- The rotation of the wind turbines now depends on the wind’s strength

[b]Fixed[/b]
- Time trial timers now start after the countdown ends, not while the countdown is still visible
- The "Go to checkpoint" button is now disabled while in cutscenes
- The player's backpack is now removed from them if they quit a mission that gave it to them
- The compass no longer shows completed missions after loading the game
- The compass now shows unlocked missions after loading the game
- Lamp posts now turn off during the day
- Ice pieces are no longer lit up at night
- Achievements now have icons
- Wind turbines now rotate in the correct direction
- The snowmobile can no longer drive on rivers

[b]Removed[/b]
- Removed the mission "A New Beginning"

[b]Known Issues[/b]
- Starting a new game after having unlocked any 'discovery text' before makes the game start at night
- The camera pushes in the opposite direction when moving 'too fast' with the mouse
- The radio does not have any UI yet
- There is no keyboard or controller button focus in the main menu when a save game does not yet exist. This can be circumvented by (temporarily) using a mouse
- Mission text may not show up when continuing the game while in a mission
- Mission interaction is possible when the player is not on their snowmobile
- The overlay that is shown when the player has crashed does not have button icons and doesn't take the player's input settings into account
- Turning on the radio again after crashing might require the radio to be turned on twice

notes.title: Til Nord Update 27-5-2021
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying Til Nord!

Patch notes for this update:

[b]Added[/b]
- Added an achievement for the destruction of all snowmen
- Added achievements for all missions
- Added countdown to time trials
- Added some more ramps

[b]Changed[/b]
- Camera can now be snapped using the arrow keys
- Separated camera behaviour for mouse and gamepad
- Changed the way air control works for mouse and keyboard players
- Made scale changes to the environment
- Hint text now has an exclamation mark next to it
- Moved the camera away from the player a bit further
- Updated rock collision
- Changed the scale of the vehicle
- The vehicle now tilts when steering
- Made changes to lighting
- Tweaked audio volume levels
- Mission UI has been revamped
- Breaking fences and snowmen no longer affects the player's momentum
- Applied some more optimization to the game (an ongoing process)

[b]Fixed[/b]
- Fixed an issue where the default frame rate text would be 0 even though the lowest slider value is 30
- Prevented title screen from affecting in-game time and weather.
- Fixed camera shake after a mission sequence
- Fix road seams in the environment
- Fixed the mission prompt being incorrect when loading the game after starting a mission
- Mission markers now remain visible if the mission is replayable
- Fixed camera clipping through the ground when ejected from the snowmobile
- Buttons no longer retain focus if the mouse hovers over them while the player is using a gamepad
- Fixed an issue with cancelling missions while in a cutscene

[b]Known Issues[/b]
- Time trial countdowns don't end at the same time as the race timer starts
- The player can still press the "Go to checkpoint" button while in a cutscene
- The player's backpack remains visible after cancelling a mission while the player has the backpack on
- The player can still drive over water
- The loading screen control sheet doesn't necessarily show correct controls
- The camera pushes in the opposite direction when moving 'too fast' with the mouse
- Some ice pieces are lit up at night
- Achievements are still lacking icons
- Completed missions show up on the compass in some cases
